channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Indonesia's most hazardous fires smolder underground
item.description: Indonesia's dangerous peat fires are starting earlier in the 2026 season due to El Niño and drought, drying out wetlands that can burn for extended periods.

item.title: Earth's magnetic field may detect dark matter signal
item.description: Scientists used Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a large detector to search for very light dark matter particles, potentially identifying a signal.

item.title: AI controls fusion plasma faster than human reaction time
item.description: Princeton researchers tested an AI system that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, outpacing human operators.

item.title: Scientists identify vulnerability in deadly brain cancer
item.description: Researchers found a potential weakness in glioblastoma's defenses. Blocking the SET protein prevented tumor formation, offering a new treatment avenue.
